dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single, thin, high-contrast yellowish-white band is clearly visible across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, prominent light-colored edges are visible along the boundaries of the folded dark flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Distinct ovoid white patch on the lateral nape region, contrasting with the black crown.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Highly distinct and linear color boundary separating the black crown from the olive-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Vibrant yellowish-green saturation on the mantle and scapulars contrasting with bluish-gray tones on the lower wing.
